title: Meetnetten.be site counts of six priority dragonflies, Flanders, Belgium, 2016-2025
creator: Piesschaert, Frederik; De Knijf, Geert; Brosens, Dimitri; Westra, Toon; Desmet, Peter; Ledegen, Hannes; Pollet, Marc (Research Institute for Nature and Forest, INBO)
citation: Piesschaert F, De Knijf G, Brosens D, Westra T, Desmet P, Ledegen H, Pollet M (2026). Meetnetten.be - Population counts for dragonflies in Flanders, Belgium. Version 1.19. Research Institute for Nature and Forest (INBO). Sampling event dataset. https://doi.org/10.15468/crbudg
abstract: Repeated site counts of adult Leucorrhinia pectoralis, Sympetrum depressiusculum, Coenagrion lunulatum, Coenagrion hastulatum, Somatochlora arctica, Leucorrhinia caudalis at 65 monitored sites in Flanders, from the Meetnetten.be priority-species monitoring network run by INBO and Natuurpunt Studie with specialised volunteers. Each site belongs to one species' project and is counted for that species only, several times in a counting year while adults fly.
samplingProtocol: Population count of adults at a fen, bog or pool in good dragonfly weather during the flight period, counting all adults of the target species at the site (De Knijf et al. 2019); several counts in a counting year.
closureNote: occasion = count within one flight season; populations may change between years (period)
surveyTaxaNote: Each site is monitored for its own project's target species only; __survey_taxa gives the taxon per unit, unit_project the project.
geographicCoverage: Flanders, Belgium (coordinates generalised by INBO to 5 km or 10 km UTM square centroids)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: Generalised by the publisher (INBO, a government agency) to the centroid of a 5 km (3536 m) or 10 km (7071 m) UTM square before publication; kept as published.

notes: y sums the adult categories the app records (male, female, unknown, copula, egg-laying), as in inbo_2026_flanders_dragonfly_count. 1 count(s) are dated outside April-September, kept as published.

notShipped.category breakdown: sex / copula / egg-laying counts summed into y
notShipped.other species: dragonflies other than the project's target, recorded at some counts only (incidental)
